Subject: Hybrid exec workshop — initial ask (Sept 28)

Hi Anita / Theo —

We have a half-day executive workshop for Acme Corp on Tue Sept 28 (08:30–13:30). High level asks: main theater-style room for 70 (U-shaped seating only for VIPs), a silent breakout for ~12 folks, and a hybrid setup that lets a small remote panel present with gallery view for attendees.

Please confirm the following by EOD Tue 9/15 if possible:
- Venue availability + preferred load-in window
- Main room capacity with U-shaped config and stage dimensions
- Recommended AV bridge (Zoom/Teams) latency expectations and whether you can provide an H.323 / SIP fallback
- On-site technician hours and contact for day-of liaison
- Any union or late-hour fees we should budget for

I attached our floor measurements (floorplan_v3.pdf) — this is the current preferred layout but willing to revise.

Thanks — will consolidate responses and share run-of-show next week.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the details and the floorplan. Sept 28 is available. Quick answers below:
- Main ballroom A (max fixed theater 120) can be configured to U-shape for ~70 with stage (12ft x 24ft) and rear AV riser.
- Load-in: 06:00–08:00 on event day; if you need earlier, we can arrange with an overtime fee.
- We work with TheaterSound (Theo copied) as preferred AV partner; they support Zoom/Teams + H.323 fallback.
- On-site tech: we can provide 10 hours of an AV lead; additional techs billed at hourly rate. Contact is me for venue logistics and Theo for AV.
- No union fees for your current timing, but there is a third-party security charge if you want secure check-in desks.

I'm attaching an updated annotated plan with power drops and load-in door specs.

Regards,
Anita Johnson
Senior Events Manager | GrandWest Hotels

From: Theo Malhotra <theo@theatersound.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hybrid exec workshop — tech rider + bridge options

Marcus / Anita / Team —

Attaching our AV rider for hybrid executive events (AV_rider_theatersound.pdf). High-level notes:
- Proposal: dual encoder setup (primary Zoom Rooms + parallel Teams feed) with RTMP redundancy to a private stream for 200 internal viewers. Encoder failover available.
- For gallery view for in-room displays we recommend two 75" screens flanking the stage + center confidence monitor for presenters.
- We can provide an H.323/SIP endpoint for Acme's legacy room if needed.
- RF mic inventory: 8 handheld, 6 lapel; we recommend 3 wireless channels reserved for panelists.

Estimate: core AV + bridge start at $5,200 (includes 1x lead tech 10 hrs, 2x techs 8 hrs, encoders, cameras, mics). Travel & hotel billed separately.

Questions: do you need an interpreted channel? Also, any strict photo/video restrictions from Acme?

Thanks,
Theo Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | TheaterSound AV
Attachment: AV_rider_theatersound.pdf (application/pdf)

Marcus / Team —

Thanks for coordinating. Confirming:
- Registered in-room attendees: 66 (plus 4 VIPs who will use the U-shaped table on stage).
- Remote-only participants expected: 38 (mostly EMEA but dial-in will be from US offices).
- Travel notes: Two execs (Y. Park and L. Tran) arrive late on 9/27 (red-eye) and require quiet greenroom access and prioritized mic checks.
- No interpretation required.
- Please do not photograph or record off-stage conversations; Acme legal will issue a short NDA addendum.

Can you confirm whether the H.323 fallback will be tested in the morning on-site? We can send our AV admin (alan.cho@acme-corp.com) if needed.
